appfunction.description: Submit one explicitly approved OpenTasker task. Side effect class: task execution. This function is disabled by default and requires user-mediated approval. It accepts only a task ID; variables, credentials, and other secret values are not accepted.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The positive ID of a task the user explicitly approved in OpenTasker.

response.description: A versioned JSON result containing only submission status and execution ID.
